newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal says on track to join euro in first wave.
newsitem.headline: Portugal says on track to join euro in first wave.

text.p: Portuguese Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said the European Union's welcome of his country's convergence programme underlined that Portugal was on track to join the European single currency at its launch.

"This welcome shows that we are on course to join the third stage of Economic and Monetary Union and that we are adopting structural policies that will boost employment," he told a news conference in Brussels, broadcast on Portuguese television.
Earlier in Brussels, EU finance ministers welcomed Portugal's economic convergence programme to qualify for the European single currency, or euro.
The Portuguese plan updates the forecast on budget deficit, debt, inflation, and other economic indicators up to 2000. -- Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254
